messages:
sara_finance: FYI vendor Emberly submitted invoice INV-2025-034 for $12,450. Scanned as PO PO-9987 but our AP system can't match  shows the PO closed in Jan. Attaching PDF. invoice-bot flagged 'no PO match' and a tax variance. Need help with approver routing and whether Finance can manual-match or we should ask vendor to reissue.

invoice-bot: OCR note: page 2 scan quality low, missing PO line item mapping. Flag: MISSING_PO_MATCH. Suggested actions: attach PO, request reissue, or create manual match (with approvals). Link: (file:INV-2025-034.pdf)

tom_ap: digging into PO-9987  it was partially consumed then closed. Created for Redwood Edge originally. @elaine_procure any idea who owns the remaining charges or if this was supposed to move to a new PO?

elaine_procure: PO-9987 was created by the project team (lead: @mike_eng) in 2024. Procurement reallocated remaining budget to PO-10045 in Feb. Emberly should have invoiced to PO-10045. @sara_finance can we ask vendor to reissue to PO-10045 or alternatively manually map?

procure-team: Confirming procurement can request vendor reissue to PO-10045. Options: (1) vendor issues credit + new invoice to PO-10045 (preferred), or (2) Finance approves manual match to cost center and we do a journal. Need sign-off from project owner.

dan_ops: I own Redwood Edge now  happy to sign off. If vendor reissues to PO-10045 that's clean. If they can't, Finance can manual match to cost center 4301 and we'll do internal adjustment. Also: what's the tax variance?

sara_finance: Invoice tax is $450 vs expected $375 (vendor billed 9% vs expected 7.5%). Vendor claims local tax change. We'll need tax evidence (tax remittance certificate or official notice). Holding payment until clarified. @tom_ap please place payment hold: `hold_payment INV-2025-034 --reason 'PO mismatch / tax variance'`.

tom_ap: Done. Payment status: HOLD (manual). Ran `erp update INV-2025-034 --hold` and added note: 'awaiting PO remap or reissue + tax proof from Emberly'. :eyes:

elaine_procure: I'll reach out to Emberly contact Sarah L. now and request (a) credit + reissue to PO-10045 OR (b) formal tax evidence if they insist on same invoice. Will update here.

procure-team: Vendor responded: "We can issue a credit and re-invoice to PO-10045. ETA 2 business days." They asked who should receive the re-issued invoice  Finance inbox or procurement?

dan_ops: Route reissued invoice to finance@redwood.com and cc procurement. I'll approve the manual match only if reissue not possible. :thumbsup:

sara_finance: Sounds good. If vendor provides tax docs instead of reissue, Finance can process a one-off manual match to cost center 4301 with approval from @dan_ops, but prefer reissue. I'll set a reminder for EOD +3 to check status. Thanks everyone  keeping payment on hold until resolved.

tom_ap: Noted. I'll keep the hold and escalate if we don't see a vendor credit by EOD +3.

procure-team: Filing follow-up ticket in procurement tracker: PRO-5462 (vendor reissue request).

sara_finance: Closing loop for now  will update thread when vendor confirms credit/invoice.
